title: Chu Songs on All Sides
synopsis: Liu Bang is relocated to the remote Hanzhong but still harbors ambitions of defeating Xiang Yu.

fullText.simplified:
四面楚歌

    秦朝没了，项羽仗着自己人马多、势力强，封自己为西楚霸王。他还任命刘邦为汉王，并派刘邦去汉中这个荒凉的地方，希望刘邦再也别来烦他。
    倘若按照约定来，是刘邦先进关中的，本来应该他是“关中王”，可以得到关中这一块广阔又重要的土地。而现在，刘邦虽然心中不服气，但又打不过项羽，也只能听项羽的，启程去汉中了。
    汉中这个地方又穷又荒凉，交通也特别不方便，从汉中去别的地方得走很长的栈道。刘邦到了汉中后，就把出去的栈道烧了，好像在告诉项羽：“我们都是好人，不会再出去跟你打了。”这样，项羽心里不免想：“不错，算你们懂事！”而他的士兵们也觉得天下已经安宁，不会有战争了。所以很多士兵都结婚生孩子了。
    但是，刘邦想要打败项羽的心一直没有变。在汉中，他请人训练军队，巩固势力，同时到处买粮食，准备打回关中。等自己的人马越来越多，实力变强后，他又派人去修那条出去的栈道，装作等栈道修好后就出兵的样子。那条栈道很长，修个几年都修不完。这让项羽以为，战争还要过几年才会来，所以并不担心。
    谁知道刘邦并没有真的想修栈道，他派去修栈道的都是一些没有战斗能力的人。而他自己早就带着主力部队偷偷从另一条很难走的山路，跋山涉水出了汉中，并很快拿下了项羽的战略要地——陈仓。
    就这样，刘邦越来越强大。他虽然还没有项羽那样雄厚的兵力，但是他多次偷偷攻打项羽，打完就跑，跑了又换个地方打。几次激烈的战役后，项羽吃了不少亏，他想要打刘邦，但是刘邦可不会乖乖等着他。项羽出身贵族，从来没有见过这么无赖的战术，所以节节败退。
    最后，项羽手下的人马越来越少，并被刘邦军队包围了。虽然项羽军队还想做最后一搏，但刘邦没有给他们这个机会。
    刘邦偷偷让他的手下学了楚国的歌曲，也就是项羽士兵们的家乡歌曲。一天晚上，项羽听见外面传来楚国的歌声，他万分惊讶地说：“刘邦得到我们这块土地了吗？他们都开始唱我们的歌了，我们的人已经认输了吗？”
    其他士兵听到家乡歌曲，想起了自己的爸爸妈妈、妻子孩子，也非常难过、泄气，都不想战斗了。
    项羽心里已经没有勇气了，觉得自己肯定输了。他们逃到一条河边，有人劝项羽：“大王，您从这里坐船过去吧，河对面还有我们的家人。我们的爷爷奶奶、爸爸妈妈都在，他们还会支持您，您还可以再回来打败刘邦。”
    项羽却只是苦笑：“我已经没有脸回去面对他们了。就算他们还肯支持我，我怎么能不愧疚呢？”
    随后，项羽就自杀了。
    项羽和刘邦的较量，项羽不仅仅是输在了战场上，更是输在了人心。刘邦愿意听别人的话，愿意善待百姓，做一个好的大王；但项羽却非常固执，他太恨秦朝，不听别人的话，杀死了很多百姓，还因为犹豫放过了刘邦。
    最终，刘邦成为了皇帝。因为先前项羽给他了一块荒凉的地方——汉中，所以刘邦就把新的国家叫作“汉朝”，而他自己也成为了汉朝的第一位皇帝，即“汉高祖”。
    后来，人们把刘邦这种表面上修栈道，实际上偷偷跑出去拿下战略要地“陈仓”的行为，称为“明修栈道，暗度陈仓”。而人们也把项羽被四面包围，听到楚国的歌声，这种危险的情况叫做“四面楚歌”。
fullText.traditional:
四面楚歌

    秦朝沒了，項羽仗著自己人馬多、勢力強，封自己為西楚霸王。他還任命劉邦為漢王，並派劉邦去漢中這個荒涼的地方，希望劉邦再也別來煩他。
    倘若按照約定來，是劉邦先進關中的，本來應該他是“關中王”，可以得到關中這一塊廣闊又重要的土地。而現在，劉邦雖然心中不服氣，但又打不過項羽，也只能聽項羽的，啟程去漢中了。
    漢中這個地方又窮又荒涼，交通也特別不方便，從漢中去別的地方得走很長的棧道。劉邦到了漢中後，就把出去的棧道燒了，好像在告訴項羽：“我們都是好人，不會再出去跟你打了。”這樣，項羽心裡不免想：“不錯，算你們懂事！”而他的士兵們也覺得天下已經安寧，不會有戰爭了。所以很多士兵都結婚生孩子了。
    但是，劉邦想要打敗項羽的心一直沒有變。在漢中，他請人訓練軍隊，鞏固勢力，同時到處買糧食，準備打回關中。等自己的人馬越來越多，實力變強後，他又派人去修那條出去的棧道，裝作等棧道修好後就出兵的樣子。那條棧道很長，修個幾年都修不完。這讓項羽以為，戰爭還要過幾年才會來，所以並不擔心。
    誰知道劉邦並沒有真的想修棧道，他派去修棧道的都是一些沒有戰鬥能力的人。而他自己早就帶著主力部隊偷偷從另一條很難走的山路，跋山涉水出了漢中，並很快拿下了項羽的戰略要地——陳倉。
    就這樣，劉邦越來越強大。他雖然還沒有項羽那樣雄厚的兵力，但是他多次偷偷攻打項羽，打完就跑，跑了又換個地方打。幾次激烈的戰役後，項羽吃了不少虧，他想要打劉邦，但是劉邦可不會乖乖等著他。項羽出身貴族，從來沒有見過這麼無賴的戰術，所以節節敗退。
    最後，項羽手下的人馬越來越少，並被劉邦軍隊包圍了。雖然項羽軍隊還想做最後一搏，但劉邦沒有給他們這個機會。
    劉邦偷偷讓他的手下學了楚國的歌曲，也就是項羽士兵們的家鄉歌曲。一天晚上，項羽聽見外面傳來楚國的歌聲，他萬分驚訝地說：“劉邦得到我們這塊土地了嗎？他們都開始唱我們的歌了，我們的人已經認輸了嗎？”
    其他士兵聽到家鄉歌曲，想起了自己的爸爸媽媽、妻子孩子，也非常難過、洩氣，都不想戰鬥了。
    項羽心裡已經沒有勇氣了，覺得自己肯定輸了。他們逃到一條河邊，有人勸項羽：“大王，您從這裡坐船過去吧，河對面還有我們的家人。我們的爺爺奶奶、爸爸媽媽都在，他們還會支持您，您還可以再回來打敗劉邦。”
    項羽卻只是苦笑：“我已經沒有臉回去面對他們了。就算他們還肯支持我，我怎麼能不愧疚呢？”
    隨後，項羽就自殺了。
    項羽和劉邦的較量，項羽不僅僅是輸在了戰場上，更是輸在了人心。劉邦願意聽別人的話，願意善待百姓，做一個好的大王；但項羽卻非常固執，他太恨秦朝，不聽別人的話，殺死了很多百姓，還因為猶豫放過了劉邦。
    最終，劉邦成為了皇帝。因為先前項羽給他了一塊荒涼的地方——漢中，所以劉邦就把新的國家叫作“漢朝”，而他自己也成為了漢朝的第一位皇帝，即“漢高祖”。
    後來，人們把劉邦這種表面上修棧道，實際上偷偷跑出去拿下戰略要地“陳倉”的行為，稱為“明修棧道，暗度陳倉”。而人們也把項羽被四面包圍，聽到楚國的歌聲，這種危險的情況叫做“四面楚歌”。

sentences.traditional: 打完就跑，跑了又換個地方打。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán jiù pǎo pǎo le yòu huàn ge dì fang dǎ
sentences.english: Although his troops were not yet as strong as Xiang Yu’s, he stealthily attacked Xiang Yu many times.

sentences.simplified: 几次激烈的战役后，项羽吃了不少亏，
sentences.traditional: 幾次激烈的戰役後，項羽吃了不少虧，
sentences.pinyin: jǐ cì jī liè de zhàn yì hòu xiàng yǔ chī le bù shǎo kuī
sentences.english: After fighting, they would run away, and after running away, they would fight in a different place.

sentences.simplified: 他想要打刘邦，但是刘邦可不会乖乖等着他。
sentences.traditional: 他想要打劉邦，但是劉邦可不會乖乖等著他。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng yào dǎ liú bāng dàn shì liú bāng kě bú huì guāi guāi děng zhe tā
sentences.english: After several fierce battles, Xiang Yu had suffered many losses.

sentences.simplified: 项羽出身贵族，从来没有见过这么无赖的战术，所以节节败退。
sentences.traditional: 項羽出身貴族，從來沒有見過這麼無賴的戰術，所以節節敗退。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ chū shēn guì zú cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè me wú lài de zhàn shù suǒ yǐ jié jié bài tuì
sentences.english: He wanted to fight Liu Bang, but Liu Bang would not obediently wait for him.
Xiang Yu, who came from a noble family, had never seen such a rogue tactic, so he was defeated at every turn.

sentences.simplified: 最后，项羽手下的人马越来越少，并被刘邦军队包围了。
sentences.traditional: 最後，項羽手下的人馬越來越少，並被劉邦軍隊包圍了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu xiàng yǔ shǒu xià de rén mǎ yuè lái yuè shǎo bìng bèi liú bāng jūn duì bāo wéi le

sentences.simplified: 虽然项羽军队还想做最后一搏，但刘邦没有给他们这个机会。
sentences.traditional: 雖然項羽軍隊還想做最後一搏，但劉邦沒有給他們這個機會。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xiàng yǔ jūn duì hái xiǎng zuò zuì hòu yì bó dàn liú bāng méi yǒu gěi tā men zhè ge jī huì
sentences.english: Finally, Xiang Yu had fewer and fewer troops, and they were surrounded by Liu Bang’s army.
Although Xiang Yu’s army still wanted to make a final stand, Liu Bang did not give them the chance.

sentences.simplified: 刘邦偷偷让他的手下学了楚国的歌曲，也就是项羽士兵们的家乡歌曲。
sentences.traditional: 劉邦偷偷讓他的手下學了楚國的歌曲，也就是項羽士兵們的家鄉歌曲。
sentences.pinyin: liú bāng tōu tōu ràng tā de shǒu xià xué le chǔ guó de gē qǔ yě jiù shì xiàng yǔ shì bīng men de jiā xiāng gē qǔ

sentences.simplified: 一天晚上，项羽听见外面传来楚国的歌声，他万分惊讶地说：
sentences.traditional: 一天晚上，項羽聽見外面傳來楚國的歌聲，他萬分驚訝地說：
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān wǎn shang xiàng yǔ tīng jiàn wài miàn chuán lái chǔ guó de gē shēng tā wàn fēn jīng yà de shuō
sentences.english: Liu Bang secretly asked his men to learn Chu songs, which were the hometown songs of Xiang Yu’s soldiers.

sentences.simplified: “刘邦得到我们这块土地了吗？他们都开始唱我们的歌了，我们的人已经认输了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “劉邦得到我們這塊土地了嗎？他們都開始唱我們的歌了，我們的人已經認輸了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: liú bāng dé dào wǒ men zhè kuài tǔ dì le ma tā men dōu kāi shǐ chàng wǒ men de gē le wǒ men de rén yǐ jīng rèn shū le ma
sentences.english: One night, Xiang Yu heard Chu songs from outside, and he said with great surprise, ..
.. “Has Liu Bang taken this land of ours? They’ve all started singing our songs. Have our people conceded defeat?”

sentences.simplified: 其他士兵听到家乡歌曲，想起了自己的爸爸妈妈、
sentences.traditional: 其他士兵聽到家鄉歌曲，想起了自己的爸爸媽媽、
sentences.pinyin: qí tā shì bīng tīng dào jiā xiāng gē qǔ xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de bà ba mā ma

sentences.simplified: 妻子孩子，也非常难过、泄气，都不想战斗了。
sentences.traditional: 妻子孩子，也非常難過、洩氣，都不想戰鬥了。
sentences.pinyin: qī zi hái zi yě fēi cháng nán guò xiè qì dōu bù xiǎng zhàn dòu le
sentences.english: When the other soldiers heard their hometown songs, they remembered their mothers and fathers and their wives and children, ..
.. and were so sad and discouraged that they didn’t want to fight anymore.

sentences.simplified: 项羽心里已经没有勇气了，觉得自己肯定输了。
sentences.traditional: 項羽心裡已經沒有勇氣了，覺得自己肯定輸了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ xīn li yǐ jīng méi yǒu yǒng qì le jué de zì jǐ kěn dìng shū le

sentences.simplified: 他们逃到一条河边，有人劝项羽：
sentences.traditional: 他們逃到一條河邊，有人勸項羽：
sentences.pinyin: tā men táo dào yì tiáo hé biān yǒu rén quàn xiàng yǔ
sentences.english: All courage had left Xiang Yu, and he felt that he had definitely lost.

sentences.simplified: “大王，您从这里坐船过去吧，河对面还有我们的家人。
sentences.traditional: “大王，您從這裡坐船過去吧，河對面還有我們的家人。
sentences.pinyin: dà wáng nín cóng zhè lǐ zuò chuán guò qu ba hé duì miàn hái yǒu wǒ men de jiā rén
sentences.english: They fled to the side of a river, and someone urged Xiang Yu, ..

sentences.simplified: 我们的爷爷奶奶、爸爸妈妈都在，他们还会支持您，您还可以再回来打败刘邦。”
sentences.traditional: 我們的爺爺奶奶、爸爸媽媽都在，他們還會支持您，您還可以再回來打敗劉邦。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men de yé ye nǎi nai bà ba mā ma dōu zài tā men hái huì zhī chí nín nín hái kě yǐ zài huí lái dǎ bài liú bāng
sentences.english: .. “King, take a boat across the river. Our families are still on the other side.
Our grandparents and parents are all there. They will still support you. You can come back again to defeat Liu Bang.”

sentences.simplified: 项羽却只是苦笑：“我已经没有脸回去面对他们了。
sentences.traditional: 項羽卻只是苦笑：“我已經沒有臉回去面對他們了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ què zhǐ shì kǔ xiào wǒ yǐ jīng méi yǒu liǎn huí qù miàn duì tā men le

sentences.simplified: 就算他们还肯支持我，我怎么能不愧疚呢？”
sentences.traditional: 就算他們還肯支持我，我怎麼能不愧疚呢？”
sentences.pinyin: jiù suàn tā men hái kěn zhī chí wǒ wǒ zěn me néng bú kuì jiù ne
sentences.english: But Xiang Yu just smiled bitterly: “I no longer command the respect to go back and face them.
Even if they are still willing to support me, how can I not feel ashamed?”

sentences.simplified: 随后，项羽就自杀了。
sentences.traditional: 隨後，項羽就自殺了。
sentences.pinyin: suí hòu xiàng yǔ jiù zì shā le

sentences.english: Soon after this, Xiang Yu committed suicide.

sentences.simplified: 项羽和刘邦的较量，
sentences.traditional: 項羽和劉邦的較量，
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ hé liú bāng de jiào liàng

sentences.simplified: 项羽不仅仅是输在了战场上，更是输在了人心。
sentences.traditional: 項羽不僅僅是輸在了戰場上，更是輸在了人心。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ bù jǐn jǐn shì shū zài le zhàn chǎng shang gèng shì shū zài le rén xīn
sentences.english: In the struggle between Xiang Yu and Liu Bang, ..

sentences.simplified: 刘邦愿意听别人的话，愿意善待百姓，做一个好的大王；
sentences.traditional: 劉邦願意聽別人的話，願意善待百姓，做一個好的大王；
sentences.pinyin: liú bāng yuàn yì tīng bié ren de huà yuàn yì shàn dài bǎi xìng zuò yí ge hǎo de dà wáng
sentences.english: .. Xiang Yu not only lost on the battlefield but also lost in the hearts of the people.

sentences.simplified: 但项羽却非常固执，他太恨秦朝，不听别人的话，
sentences.traditional: 但項羽卻非常固執，他太恨秦朝，不聽別人的話，
sentences.pinyin: dàn xiàng yǔ què fēi cháng gù zhí tā tài hèn qín cháo bù tīng bié ren de huà
sentences.english: Liu Bang was willing to listen to others and willing to treat ordinary people well and be a good king.

sentences.simplified: 杀死了很多百姓，还因为犹豫放过了刘邦。
sentences.traditional: 殺死了很多百姓，還因為猶豫放過了劉邦。
sentences.pinyin: shā sǐ le hěn duō bǎi xìng hái yīn wèi yóu yù fàng guò le liú bāng
sentences.english: But Xiang Yu was very stubborn. He hated the Qin Dynasty too much to listen to others.
He killed many ordinary people and let Liu Bang slip by because of his hesitation.

sentences.simplified: 最终，刘邦成为了皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 最終，劉邦成為了皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhōng liú bāng chéng wéi le huáng dì

sentences.simplified: 因为先前项羽给他了一块荒凉的地方——汉中，所以刘邦就把新的国家叫作“汉朝”，
sentences.traditional: 因為先前項羽給他了一塊荒涼的地方——漢中，所以劉邦就把新的國家叫作“漢朝”，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xiān qián xiàng yǔ gěi tā le yí kuài huāng liáng de dì fang hàn zhōng suǒ yǐ liú bāng jiù bǎ xīn de guó jiā jiào zuò hàn cháo
sentences.english: In the end, Liu Bang became the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 而他自己也成为了汉朝的第一位皇帝，即“汉高祖”。
sentences.traditional: 而他自己也成為了漢朝的第一位皇帝，即“漢高祖”。
sentences.pinyin: ér tā zì jǐ yě chéng wéi le hàn cháo de dì yī wèi huáng dì jí hàn gāo zǔ
sentences.english: Because Xiang Yu had previously given him a desolate place–Hanzhong, Liu Bang called the new country the “Han Dynasty”.
He became the first emperor of the Han Dynasty, namely “Han Gaozu”.

sentences.simplified: 后来，人们把刘邦这种表面上修栈道，
sentences.traditional: 後來，人們把劉邦這種表面上修棧道，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái rén men bǎ liú bāng zhè zhǒng biǎo miàn shang xiū zhàn dào

sentences.simplified: 实际上偷偷跑出去拿下战略要地“陈仓”的行为，
sentences.traditional: 實際上偷偷跑出去拿下戰略要地“陳倉”的行為，
sentences.pinyin: shí jì shang tōu tōu pǎo chū qù ná xià zhàn lüè yào dì chén cāng de xíng wéi
sentences.english: Later, Liu Bang making a show of repairing the plank road, ..

sentences.simplified: 称为“明修栈道，暗度陈仓”。
sentences.traditional: 稱為“明修棧道，暗度陳倉”。
sentences.pinyin: chēng wéi míng xiū zhàn dào àn dù chén cāng
sentences.english: .. while actually covertly leaving to take the strategic location of “Chencang”, ..

sentences.simplified: 而人们也把项羽被四面包围，听到楚国的歌声，这种危险的情况叫做“四面楚歌”。
sentences.traditional: 而人們也把項羽被四面包圍，聽到楚國的歌聲，這種危險的情況叫做“四面楚歌”。
sentences.pinyin: ér rén men yě bǎ xiàng yǔ bèi sì miàn bāo wéi tīng dào chǔ guó de gē shēng zhè zhǒng wēi xiǎn de qíng kuàng jiào zuò sì miàn chǔ gē
sentences.english: .. became known among the people as “openly repairing the plank road while secretly crossing the river at Chencang”.

sentence_translations: Chu Songs on All Sides
The Qin Dynasty was no more. Xiang Yu, using his many troops and great power, made himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu.
He also appointed Liu Bang as the King of Han and sent him to the desolate Hanzhong, ..
.. hoping that Liu Bang would never bother him again.
According to the agreement, since Liu Bang had been the first to enter Guanzhong, ..
.. he should have been the “King of Guanzhong” and would have obtained the vast and important territory of Guanzhong.
But now, although Liu Bang was unwilling to accept it, he could not beat Xiang Yu, ..
.. and had no choice but to do as Xiang Yu said and set out for Hanzhong.
Hanzhong was a poor and desolate place, and transportation was particularly inconvenient.
If you wanted to leave Hanzhong for somewhere else, you had to travel across a long plank road.
When Liu Bang arrived at Hanzhong, he burned the plank road of Hanzhong as if to tell Xiang Yu, ..
.. “We are all good people and will not go out to fight you again.”
This inevitably made Xiang Yu think to himself, “Not bad, you are sensible!”
His soldiers felt that the world was at peace and that there would be no more war.
So many soldiers got married and had children.
However, Liu Bang’s intention to defeat Xiang Yu did not change.
In Hanzhong, he hired people to train his troops and consolidated his power.
Meanwhile, he bought grain everywhere and prepared to return to fight Guanzhong.
While waiting for the number of his men to increase and his troops to become stronger, ..
.. he sent people to fix the plank road out of Hanzhong, ..
.. pretending that he would wait for the plank road to be repaired before sending out his troops.
That plank road was very long, and repairing it would take several years.
This made Xiang Yu think that the war would not come for several years, so he was not worried at all.
Who would have imagined that Liu Bang did not really want to repair the plank road?
The people that he sent to repair the plank road were people who were not good at fighting.
He had already covertly taken his main forces out via another torturous mountain road.
They traveled far out of Hanzhong and quickly took one of Xiang Yu’s strategic locations—Chencang.
In this way, Liu Bang became more and more powerful.
Although his troops were not yet as strong as Xiang Yu’s, he stealthily attacked Xiang Yu many times.
After fighting, they would run away, and after running away, they would fight in a different place.
After several fierce battles, Xiang Yu had suffered many losses.
He wanted to fight Liu Bang, but Liu Bang would not obediently wait for him.
Xiang Yu, who came from a noble family, had never seen such a rogue tactic, so he was defeated at every turn.
Finally, Xiang Yu had fewer and fewer troops, and they were surrounded by Liu Bang’s army.
Although Xiang Yu’s army still wanted to make a final stand, Liu Bang did not give them the chance.
Liu Bang secretly asked his men to learn Chu songs, which were the hometown songs of Xiang Yu’s soldiers.
One night, Xiang Yu heard Chu songs from outside, and he said with great surprise, ..
.. “Has Liu Bang taken this land of ours? They’ve all started singing our songs. Have our people conceded defeat?”
When the other soldiers heard their hometown songs, they remembered their mothers and fathers and their wives and children, ..
.. and were so sad and discouraged that they didn’t want to fight anymore.
All courage had left Xiang Yu, and he felt that he had definitely lost.
They fled to the side of a river, and someone urged Xiang Yu, ..
.. “King, take a boat across the river. Our families are still on the other side.
Our grandparents and parents are all there. They will still support you. You can come back again to defeat Liu Bang.”
But Xiang Yu just smiled bitterly: “I no longer command the respect to go back and face them.
Even if they are still willing to support me, how can I not feel ashamed?”
Soon after this, Xiang Yu committed suicide.
In the struggle between Xiang Yu and Liu Bang, ..
.. Xiang Yu not only lost on the battlefield but also lost in the hearts of the people.
Liu Bang was willing to listen to others and willing to treat ordinary people well and be a good king.
But Xiang Yu was very stubborn. He hated the Qin Dynasty too much to listen to others.
He killed many ordinary people and let Liu Bang slip by because of his hesitation.
In the end, Liu Bang became the emperor.
Because Xiang Yu had previously given him a desolate place–Hanzhong, Liu Bang called the new country the “Han Dynasty”.
He became the first emperor of the Han Dynasty, namely “Han Gaozu”.
Later, Liu Bang making a show of repairing the plank road, ..
.. while actually covertly leaving to take the strategic location of “Chencang”, ..
.. became known among the people as “openly repairing the plank road while secretly crossing the river at Chencang”.
Also, people call the type of dangerous situation when Xiang Yu was surrounded on all sides and heard Chu songs: “Chu songs on all sides”.
